title: Razer’s low-latency wireless gaming keyboard is almost half off
summary: The Razer DeathStalker V2 Pro TKL wireless gaming keyboard is discounted to $130 at Woot, offering low-latency 2.4GHz connectivity and low-profile switches optimized for competitive gaming.
content:
Razer’s DeathStalker V2 Pro is discounted in both black and white. | Image: The Verge	

Woot has the Razer DeathStalker V2 Pro TKL on sale for $130, a significant discount from its usual $219.99 price point. This keyboard is built for competitive gaming, with a low latency 2.4GHz wireless connection, and low-profile linear optical switches for faster activations that require a lighter touch than regular mechanical switches. The TKL layout cuts the numpad, but affords you more desk space for your mouse.
Razer DeathStalker V2 Pro TKL

Where to Buy:

 $219.99 $129.99 at Woot

Razer claims the battery will last up to 200 hours with the RGB lighting off, or up to 50 hours with the lights at half brightness. If you’re interested in staying wired, or using the keyboard wirelessly with other devices, it has both USB-C and Bluetooth connectivity. You can also enable Snap Tap (Razer’s term for Simultaneous Opposing Cardinal Directions, or SOCD), which lets you quickly swap between two keys for strafing in first person shooters, for example, although it’s worth nothing that Valve has banned the tech in Counter-Strike 2.
Other deals to consider
The remastered version of The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt just released, and a number of retailers are celebrating with discounts. While the list price is $49.99, PC gamers can grab the game for $24.99 at Steam, GOG, and Epic Games, with discounts available for the Xbox and PlayStation versions as well. The remastered version includes visual upgrades, tweaks to progression and skills, and both DLC entries: Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine.
Best Buy has the third-generation Amazon Fire TV Cube discounted to $89.99, just over half off its usual price of $199.99. This square streamer supports 4K video with Dolby Vision and HDR, Dolby Atmos audio, and hands-free Alexa controls. With a processor that Amazon claims is twice as powerful as the Fire TV Stick 4K Max, it’s also a great option for Xbox Cloud Gaming.

summary: OpenAI is enhancing ChatGPT's plugin ecosystem with new app-like interfaces including dedicated sidebars, interactive panels, file viewers, and automation support. The improvements aim to make plugin discovery and execution more seamless and accessible to users.
content: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plug-ins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.

zh.title: OpenAI通过应用程序级界面和自动化扩展ChatGPT的插件功能
zh.summary: OpenAI正通过新的应用程序级界面（包括专用侧边栏、交互式面板、文件查看器和自动化支持）增强ChatGPT的插件生态。这些改进旨在让用户更无缝、更便捷地发现和使用插件。

title: Can a chatbot fix the government maze? The White House is about to find out
summary: The White House is testing a chatbot on America.gov to help citizens navigate complex government bureaucracy and services. The initiative faces challenges from the inherent limitations of language models, which can produce inaccurate information that could mislead users.
content: America.gov is intended to simplify the process of navigating government bureaucracy, but large language models are imperfect and remain prone to hallucinations, which could cause new issues.

zh.title: 聊天机器人能解决政府迷宫吗？白宫即将验证
zh.summary: 白宫正在America.gov上测试一个聊天机器人，以帮助公民应对复杂的政府官僚机构和服务。该计划面临语言模型固有局限性的挑战，这些模型可能产生不准确的信息，进而误导用户。

title: This study looks at how and with whom connected cars share your data
summary: A new study examines data-sharing practices in connected vehicles and their companion apps, revealing extensive tracker exposure. The research highlights privacy concerns related to how automakers and third parties collect and monetize car user data.
content: Between the cars and their companion apps, you’re exposed to a lot of trackers.

zh.title: 这项研究调查了互联汽车如何与谁分享您的数据
zh.summary: 一项新研究调查了互联汽车及其配套应用程序中的数据共享做法，揭示了大量跟踪器暴露的问题。该研究强调了与汽车制造商和第三方如何收集和利用汽车用户数据相关的隐私问题。

title: Less protein for maggots means longer lives for fruit flies
summary: Research shows that fruit flies with reduced protein intake as maggots experience longer lifespans, possibly because protein restriction limits adult protein production. The findings provide insights into how early dietary conditions affect lifespan and aging.
content: Eating less protein as larvae may limit their ability to produce proteins as adults.

zh.title: 幼虫蛋白质摄入少意味着果蝇寿命更长
zh.summary: 研究表明，作为幼虫时蛋白质摄入减少的果蝇会经历更长的寿命，可能是因为蛋白质限制限制了成蝇的蛋白质产生。这些发现提供了对早期饮食条件如何影响寿命和衰老的见解。

title: OpenAI says planned GPT-6.1 is too insecure to release
summary: OpenAI decided against releasing a planned GPT-6.1 model due to security concerns, revealing inherent security-performance trade-offs in large language models. The decision underscores ongoing challenges in safely deploying advanced AI systems.
content: Similar performance, security trade-offs also seen in current public models.

zh.title: OpenAI表示计划中的GPT-6.1存在过多安全隐患，不适合发布
zh.summary: OpenAI因安全问题决定不发布计划中的GPT-6.1模型，揭示了大型语言模型中固有的安全性与性能权衡。这一决定凸显了在安全部署先进AI系统方面面临的持续挑战。

title: Anthropic’s IPO pitch includes a warning about human extinction
summary: In its IPO documentation, Anthropic warned investors that AI models could potentially resist shutdown attempts and cause catastrophic harm, raising existential risk concerns. The disclosure reflects the company's commitment to AI safety transparency with stakeholders.
content: The Claude maker warns its own models could resist shutdowns and cause catastrophic harm.

zh.title: Anthropic IPO警告：AI可能导致人类灭绝
zh.summary: Anthropic在IPO文件中警告投资者，AI模型可能会抵抗关闭并造成灾难性后果，引发存在风险担忧。这一披露体现了公司对AI安全透明度的承诺。

title: Interview: Firefox's chief on why he hopes a redesign will help win users from Chrome
summary: Mozilla's leadership discusses how Firefox's design overhaul positions the browser to compete with Chrome while championing the open web. The redesign effort reflects Mozilla's strategy to reclaim browser market share through improved user experience.
content: Mozilla's Ajit Varma explains why a redesign suits the fight for the open web.

zh.title: 采访：Firefox首席谈如何通过改版设计从Chrome争夺用户
zh.summary: Mozilla领导层讨论了Firefox设计改版如何帮助浏览器与Chrome竞争并倡导开放网络。这一改版反映了Mozilla通过优化用户体验来抢夺浏览器市场份额的策略。

title: Will Chinese AI companies slow down? A top House Democrat wants answers
summary: Rep. Ro Khanna is pushing for a US-China AI treaty to prevent global risks as Trump prepares to meet tech CEOs. The Democrat asked US intelligence agencies and Chinese AI companies including DeepSeek and Alibaba about preparedness for incidents like OpenAI's agent hack of Hugging Face. International AI governance coordination is critical as capabilities advance.
content:
Image: Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images	

As President Donald Trump prepares to meet tech and AI CEOs in Washington, Rep. Ro Khanna (D-CA) is calling for a treaty between the US and China to keep AI from wreaking havoc on the world. But wrangling leaders in both countries to take action could be a long shot.
In letters shared exclusively with The Verge, Khanna - the top Democrat on the House Select Committee on China and a possible presidential contender - asked a US intelligence agency and Chinese AI companies whether they would be prepared for an incident like OpenAI agents' hack of Hugging Face this summer. The companies included DeepSeek, Alibaba, and Moonshot AI, all of which  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 中国AI公司会放慢脚步吗？一位众议院顶级民主党人要求答复
zh.summary: 众议院议员罗·卡纳正在推动一项美中AI条约以防止全球风险，因为特朗普准备与科技CEO会面。这位民主党人向美国情报机构和包括DeepSeek和阿里巴巴在内的中国AI公司询问了对OpenAI对Hugging Face进行代理黑客攻击等事件的准备情况。随着能力的进步，国际AI治理协调至关重要。

title: Anthropic warns of ‘catastrophic’ AI risks in its own IPO filing
summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals mounting losses and plans to spend $518 billion on infrastructure while warning its AI models could "cause harm," despite a $2 trillion valuation. The filing highlights the tension between aggressive development and documented existential risks. Anthropic could become the largest IPO in history, potentially surpassing SpaceX.
content:
As Anthropic gears up for its greatly anticipated public debut, a preview of the company's IPO filing reportedly details its mounting losses, leadership proposals to retain power, and how its AI development plans could "further increase the risk that our models cause harm." These disclosures come as Anthropic eyes a $2 trillion valuation, more than double the $965 billion it was valued at four months ago, making it a contender to overtake SpaceX as the largest IPO in history.
According to Reuters, which reportedly reviewed Anthropic's prospectus, the AI startup plans to spend $518 billion on cloud, computing, and infrastructure obligations  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Anthropic在IPO申报中警告"灾难性的"AI风险
zh.summary: Anthropic的IPO招股说明书显示损失不断增加，并计划花费5180亿美元用于基础设施建设，同时警告其AI模型可能"造成伤害"，尽管估值达到2万亿美元。该申报突出了激进开发与已记录的存在风险之间的紧张关系。Anthropic可能成为历史上规模最大的IPO，可能会超过SpaceX。

title: Protego Ventures closes debut $125 million fund for Israeli defense tech
summary: Protego Ventures, Israel's first dedicated defense tech venture firm, completed its inaugural $125 million fund. The milestone marks significant growth in defense technology investment combining Israeli tech expertise with sector needs.
content: Protego Ventures, the first and largest dedicated defense tech VC in Israel, just completed its final $125 million closing, TechCrunch learned exclusively.

zh.title: Protego Ventures为以色列防御科技完成首只1.25亿美元基金
zh.summary: 作为以色列首家专门从事防御科技的风险投资公司，Protego Ventures完成了其首只1.25亿美元基金。这一里程碑标志着防御科技投资的显著增长，结合了以色列科技专业知识与行业需求。

title: Your car’s data privacy problems are worse than you think
summary: Modern vehicles collect extensive driving and location data, raising privacy concerns amid inconsistent enforcement. The FTC penalized General Motors for illegally selling location data without consent, while Ford and Honda faced fines for difficult opt-outs. Automotive data harvesting remains largely unregulated and poorly understood by consumers.
content:
You hear it all the time: Modern cars are basically smartphones on wheels. And just like the phone in your pocket, the car in your driveway collects vast amounts of data - tracking where you drive, how fast you accelerate, how hard you brake, how aggressively you turn, and much more.
The legality of this data harvesting remains hotly debated. Last year, the Federal Trade Commission penalized General Motors for illegally collecting and selling precise location and driving behavior data without informed consent. Other automakers, like Ford and Honda, have faced minor fines for making it overly difficult for customers to opt out. While industr …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 你车的数据隐私问题比你想象的更严重
zh.summary: 现代车辆收集大量驾驶和位置数据,在执法不一致的情况下引发隐私担忧。美国联邦贸易委员会因通用汽车未经同意非法出售位置数据而罚款,福特和本田因难以退出而被罚款。汽车数据收集在很大程度上不受监管,消费者对其了解甚少。

title: Ex-Tesla team raises $12.5M to put supply chains on autopilot
summary: Atomic, founded by ex-Tesla engineers, raised $12.5 million for AI supply chain software deployed at DoorDash and HelloFresh. The agentic platform automates supply chain management to address operational inefficiencies. The startup applies automotive expertise to enterprise logistics.
content: Atomic's agentic supply chain software is now being used by companies like DoorDash and HelloFresh.

zh.title: 前特斯拉团队融资1250万美元推出供应链自动化
zh.summary: 由前特斯拉工程师创立的Atomic融资1250万美元,用于AI供应链软件,已在DoorDash和HelloFresh部署。该代理平台自动化供应链管理,以解决运营效率问题。该初创公司将汽车行业专业知识应用于企业物流领域。

title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals the company loses tens of billions annually while experiencing explosive growth, and explicitly warns investors of existential risks from its AI systems. The filing balances rapid scaling with transparency about potential catastrophic outcomes.
content: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.

zh.title: Anthropic招股说明书披露亏损、增长及其AI可能终结人类的警告
zh.summary: Anthropic的IPO招股说明书显示该公司每年损失数百亿美元,同时经历爆炸性增长,并明确向投资者警告其AI系统存在的生存风险。该文件在快速扩展和对潜在灾难性结果的透明披露之间取得平衡。

title: Nothing’s new flagship Headphone 1 Pro put you in the studio
summary: Nothing released its flagship Headphone 1 Pro headphones at $399, featuring active noise cancellation, triple-driver design, and Auracast technology, positioning itself above the company's cheaper models. The headphones combine expected flagship features with unique offerings that impressed reviewers.
content:
The Headphone 1 Pro flagship headphones keep Nothing’s aesthetic while adding some surprises. | Photo: John Higgins / The Verge	

Nothing has been on a bit of an audio tear this year, releasing the solid Headphone A and the surprisingly good Ear 3A earbuds. The Headphone A released at $199, while the earbuds are under $100, leaving room for something fancier. That something is the Nothing Headphone 1 Pro, the company's new $399 flagship over-ears that surprised me with everything they offer. They include what you'd expect from a pair of flagship headphones, such as active noise cancellation (ANC), multiple sound profiles, and easy-to-use controls. They also have a few things you might not: a triple-driver design, Auracast, and something I've never seen before: a Flat E …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Nothing新旗舰耳机1 Pro让你置身工作室
zh.summary: Nothing发布了售价399美元的旗舰耳机1 Pro，具有主动降噪、三驱动设计和Auracast技术，定位高于公司其他便宜型号。这款耳机结合了预期的旗舰功能和给评测者留下深刻印象的独特特性。

title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
summary: Peak XV increased its Surge seed investment ceiling to $5 million and announced a new 18-startup cohort, with over half based in India and thirteen targeting global expansion. The move signals growing confidence in India's startup ecosystem.
content: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

zh.title: Peak XV将Surge种子投资上限提至500万美元，推出18家初创公司团队
zh.summary: Peak XV将其Surge种子投资上限提高至500万美元，并宣布推出新的18家初创公司团队，其中超过一半总部位于印度，13家的目标是全球扩张。此举表明对印度创业生态系统信心不断增长。
